package spinal.core.internals

import spinal.core._

/** Vector form of the already-qualified scalar full/tail recurrence. The
  * native operator proof supplies every per-leaf transfer; this object only
  * applies the authoritative balanced-tree geometry to those transfers.
  */
private[spinal] object TypedBalancedReductionCompositeWidthSchedule {
  type Width = ElaborationIntegerExpression

  private def fail(code: String, detail: String): Nothing =
    throw new IllegalArgumentException(s"MORPH-REDUCE-BALANCED-COMPOSITE-SCHEDULE-$code: $detail")

  final case class WidthStage(
      inputFull: Vector[Width], inputTail: Vector[Width],
      outputFull: Vector[Width], outputTail: Vector[Width],
      fullPairPossible: Boolean, fullInput: Vector[Width],
      fullPairActive: ElaborationBooleanExpression,
      partialLeft: Vector[Width], partialRight: Vector[Width],
      partialPairActive: ElaborationBooleanExpression,
      partialPairPossible: Boolean, tailPossible: Boolean,
      inputPacked: Width, outputPacked: Width)

  final case class WidthSchedule(stages: Vector[WidthStage],
      terminal: Vector[Width], initialPacked: Width)

  private def total(widths: Vector[Width]): Width = {
    if (widths == null || widths.isEmpty) fail("EMPTY", "composite width vector cannot be empty")
    widths.tail.foldLeft(widths.head) { case (left, right) =>
      ElaborationWidthAuthority.add(left, right)
    }
  }

  private def possible(widths: Vector[Width], active: ElaborationBooleanExpression,
      label: String): Boolean = {
    val values = widths.map(width => ElaborationWidthAuthority.minimumWhen(width, active).nonEmpty).distinct
    if (values.size != 1) fail("DOMAIN", s"$label leaves disagree on their active parameter domain")
    values.head
  }

  private def choose(active: ElaborationBooleanExpression,
      yes: Vector[Width], no: Vector[Width]): Vector[Width] = {
    if (yes.size != no.size) fail("SHAPE", "width transfer changed the recursive leaf inventory")
    yes.zip(no).map { case (a, b) => ElaborationWidthAuthority.choose(active, a, b) }
  }

  def widths(plan: TypedBalancedReductionPlan, leaves: Vector[Width],
      operator: Option[TypedBalancedReductionCompositeReplay.OperatorProof]): WidthSchedule = {
    if (plan == null || leaves == null || leaves.isEmpty)
      fail("NULL", "typed plan and nonempty composite leaf widths are required")
    leaves.foreach(width => ElaborationWidthAuthority.requireAuthoritative(width,
      "composite balanced input width", "MORPH-REDUCE-BALANCED-COMPOSITE-SCHEDULE-WIDTH"))
    var full = leaves
    var tail = leaves
    val initialPacked = ElaborationWidthAuthority.multiply(total(leaves), plan.count.expression)
    var packed = initialPacked
    val stages = plan.stages.map { geometry =>
      val proof = operator.getOrElse(fail("OPERATOR", "an active composite stage needs a certified native operator"))
      val fullActive = plan.count >= ElabInt.fromBigInt(BigInt(1) << (geometry.level + 1))
      val fullPairPossible = possible(full, fullActive.expression, "full-pair")
      val fullInput = full.map { width =>
        val minimum = ElaborationWidthAuthority.minimumWhen(width, fullActive.expression)
        val maximum = ElaborationWidthAuthority.maximumWhen(width, fullActive.expression)
        if (minimum.isEmpty != maximum.isEmpty)
          fail("DOMAIN", "full-pair width extrema disagree on their exact active domain")
        if (maximum.exists(_ < width.maximum))
          ElaborationWidthAuthority.choose(fullActive.expression, width,
            ElabInt.fromBigInt(minimum.get).expression)
        else width
      }
      val paired = geometry.active && !geometry.hasOddTail
      val partialPairPossible = possible(full, paired.expression, "partial-left")
      if (partialPairPossible != possible(tail, paired.expression, "partial-right"))
        fail("DOMAIN", "partial-pair sides disagree on their exact active domain")
      val partialLeft = full.map { width =>
        ElaborationWidthAuthority.minimumWhen(width, paired.expression)
          .map(minimum => ElaborationWidthAuthority.choose(paired.expression, width,
            ElabInt.fromBigInt(minimum).expression)).getOrElse(width)
      }
      val partialRight = tail.map { width =>
        ElaborationWidthAuthority.minimumWhen(width, paired.expression)
          .map(minimum => ElaborationWidthAuthority.choose(paired.expression, width,
            ElabInt.fromBigInt(minimum).expression)).getOrElse(width)
      }
      val nextTail = if (partialPairPossible)
        choose(paired.expression, proof.resultWidthsFor(partialLeft, partialRight), tail)
      else tail
      val nextFull = if (fullPairPossible) proof.resultWidthsFor(fullInput, fullInput) else nextTail
      val outputPacked = ElaborationWidthAuthority.add(
        ElaborationWidthAuthority.multiply(total(nextFull), (geometry.outputCount - 1).expression),
        total(nextTail))
      val stage = WidthStage(full, tail, nextFull, nextTail, fullPairPossible, fullInput,
        fullActive.expression, partialLeft, partialRight, paired.expression, partialPairPossible,
        !geometry.hasOddTail.isAlwaysFalse, packed, outputPacked)
      full = nextFull
      tail = nextTail
      packed = outputPacked
      stage
    }
    WidthSchedule(stages, tail, initialPacked)
  }
}
